title: Knowledge
no_results_hint: Every word has to appear on the same line. Try other words, or fewer of them.
empty_tag_body: Clear the filter to see everything in {kind}.
empty_body: Persona sorts your Lark and email conversations into projects, people, docs and meetings on its own, and ranks them by importance and relevance.
empty_events_body: Events from a calendar you've connected, such as Lark, show up here.
empty_recordings_body: Record a meeting or a conversation on your phone, and its transcript shows up here.
no_tags: No tags in this type yet.
empty_topics_body: In the background, Persona pulls durable knowledge out of your project timelines and chats (concepts, decisions, how-tos, pitfalls, facts) and files it under topics. Topics appear here as it goes.
map_title: See topics and projects as a mind map
delete_confirm: "{name}" leaves the lists, search and the assistant's context. Its chats, people and documents stay; they just stop naming it. You can undo this right after.
restore_conflict: Couldn't restore "{name}": a newer project has the same name.
